Subject: MSA + Order Form: Transfer Annex sequencing & evidence matrix

Claire/Evan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching a first-pass Transfer Annex (Transfer_Annex_Draft.pdf) and an initial delivery plan so legal can sequence the sign-off tasks against the MSA + Order Form redline. High-level asks: 

- Can your legal team confirm whether Asteria accepts Redwood as a "processor" for the listed features (page 2 of the draft)?
- We need SCCs mapping confirmation (which set you prefer) and a named evidence owner for audit items (encryption at rest, KMS, export controls).
- Proposed timeline: legal redlines back by EOD 2027-08-30; procurement to confirm commercial carve-outs by 2027-08-31.

Attachments: Transfer_Annex_Draft.pdf (draft), SCCs-mapping.xlsx (working tab in Drive will be shared).

I know this timeline is tight for GDPR-heavy accounts — if we need to extend, flag now.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

+1 415-555-0123

Laura —

Thanks for the draft and the clear timeline. I attached our internal redlines (Asteria_MSA_redlines_v1.docx) — most comments are around processor/processor-roles and the retention windows. A few quick points: 

- We generally treat the vendor as "processor" but need explicit clarification on subprocessing and onshore/offshore routing (some clinical data must remain in EU).
- SCCs: our legal team prefers the latest EU Commission addendum; we will mark up the SCCs mapping sheet and upload.
- Evidence owners: I’ve assigned preliminary owners internally; I’ll share the owner matrix by EOD 8/29.

Forwarding Ben and Karthik to work details with you.

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: Transfer Annex sequencing & evidence matrix

Claire/Laura —

Thanks for the redlines, Claire — reviewed the doc and pulled together initial notes. Key items from legal: 

- Role mapping: Redwood accepts processor role but requests a limited subprocessor delegation clause (we propose customer consent for new subprocessors for controller-level clinical data).
- SCCs: we'll align to the same EU Commission addendum. See our suggested mapping in SCCs-mapping.xlsx (I dropped a tab called "Redwood-suggested" with specific clause ties).
- Retention: we can support a 30-day ephemeral retention for non-billing training telemetry but need an explicit carve-out in the Order Form for logs required for security.
- Export routing: propose primary EU region with documented fallback to US region for DR — will document controls and applicable legal justification in the Transfer Annex.

Action items for clarity and sequencing:
1) Claire: please confirm which specific data classes must be EU-resident at rest (clinical_phr, lab_results, imaging_meta).
2) Evan: confirm procurement constraints on the Order Form carve-outs (pricing/term impacts).
3) Laura/Karthik: update Order Form exhibits to reflect the retention carve-out and subprocessor consent flow.

I uploaded SCCs-mapping.xlsx to the shared drive and linked tabs to the redlines. If we can get confirmations on 1/2 by end of day tomorrow, we should be able to produce a consolidated redline by EOD 2027-08-31.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@asteriahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Martin <claire.martin@asteriahealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: Transfer Annex sequencing & evidence matrix

Laura/Ben —

Quick answers from procurement & product: 

- Data classes that must remain in the EU at rest: clinical_phr and imaging_meta. Lab_results can be routed for processing to the US if masked; we will provide masking rules.
- Pricing: a narrow EU-only hosting premium is acceptable; we need the procurement team to produce a final Amendment 1 to the Order Form if EU-only routing is requested.
- Retention: 30-day ephemeral retention for model training telemetry is acceptable with audit logs retained for 180 days for security incidents.

Attaching a short doc with our architecture notes (Procurement_Techstack.pdf). We will align legal owners to the SCCs-mapping sheet by COB 8/30.

Evan Lowe
Director, Procurement | Asteria Health
evan.lowe@asteriahealth.com
